# Leonardo Gotardo

> Software Developer based in Londrina, Brazil. Specializing in embedded Linux and IoT, Python backends, and full-stack web/mobile development. Currently working at IrisPay (Brazilian fintech) and partner at TLG-Web-Dev. Graduated in Analysis and Systems Development at IFPR (2026).

## About

Leonardo Gotardo is a Software Developer based in Londrina, Paraná, Brazil. He works at IrisPay — a Brazilian fintech converting traditional machines into smart vending systems via proprietary payment technology — working across embedded systems, automation, REST APIs, sockets, cryptography, IoT, and web development.

He graduated in Analysis and Systems Development at IFPR in 2026 and keeps building open-source side projects covering cryptography, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure, algorithms, and Python libraries published on PyPI.

- Location: Londrina, Paraná, Brazil
- Languages: Portuguese (Native), English (Full Professional)
- Education: Analysis & Systems Development — IFPR (2022–2026)

## Experience

### Software Developer — IrisPay (Sep 2024 — Present)
Brazilian fintech converting traditional machines into smart vending systems via proprietary payment technology. Londrina-PR, Brazil.
- Embedded Linux on unattended Raspberry Pi devices: kiosk display, systemd services, watchdogs and disk encryption
- Python services that control hardware — GPIO, NFC readers, serial protocols and thermal printers
- FastAPI/Flask REST APIs and real-time WebSocket communication
- Over-the-air updates with automatic rollback for devices in the field
- Web development for internal and client-facing systems, including a legacy PHP (Yii2) platform
Tags: Embedded Linux, Raspberry Pi, Python, FastAPI, IoT, NFC, RFID, WebSocket, PHP

### Partner — TLG-Web-Dev (Apr 2026 — Present)
Small web development studio; one of the partners, building client sites.
- Client sites with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
- Locked the Next.js Image Optimizer to fixed hosts, closing an open-proxy hole
- Server-validated contact form, rate-limited per IP
- Technical SEO (canonical domain, robots policy for AI crawlers) and analytics
Tags: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SEO, Web Security

### Service Desk — Persis Internet (Jul 2023 — Mar 2024)
Regional ISP with 100k+ clients. Londrina-PR, Brazil.
- Diagnosed and resolved complex network issues from ambiguous customer descriptions
- Delivered high-quality technical support under pressure
- Converted recurring client issues into actionable internal feedback
Tags: Networking, Technical Support, Problem Solving, Customer Service

## Projects

### noHarm (Dec 2025 — Present)
Mobile addiction recovery app with a JavaScript/Capacitor frontend and a FastAPI backend (Clean Architecture). Real-time chat, streak tracking, and AES-256 encrypted user data.
- Vite + Capacitor frontend for web and mobile, E2E tested with Playwright
- FastAPI REST API with JWT authentication and token blacklisting
- Real-time messaging via Socket.IO WebSockets
- Streak tracking system with achievement badges
- AES-256 field-level encryption, rate limiting, XSS sanitization
- Three-layer rate limiting on Redis with atomic Lua scripts
- Backend on AWS (ECS, RDS) provisioned with Terraform; 1,170 pytest test cases and Playwright E2E
- [Live](https://noharm.site)
- [GitHub (frontend)](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/noHarm)
- [GitHub (backend)](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/noHarmBack)
- Stack: JavaScript, Capacitor, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, JWT, AWS, Terraform

### ReportGen (Feb 2026 — Present)
Web tool for building structured technical reports with live preview and multi-format export — bug reports, study records, and changelogs.
- Three templates: Bug Report (security findings), Study Report (learning records), Changelog (version history)
- Export to PDF (server-rendered via Puppeteer), DOCX (client-side), Print, and JSON
- Full-stack: React 19 + Vite frontend, Express + Puppeteer backend
- PT/EN i18n, live preview, rate limiting, and input validation
- [Live](https://reportgen.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/reportGen)
- Stack: React, JavaScript, Vite, Express, Puppeteer, Render

### ipTool (Mar 2026 — Present)
Geographic IP lookup tool with interactive Leaflet map, IPv4/IPv6 validation, and detailed network data.
- IPv4 and IPv6 address validation
- Interactive Leaflet map with precise coordinate markers
- Network data: connection type, routing, ISP information
- Location details: timezone, languages, calling codes, EU membership
- [Live](https://iptool.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/ipTool)
- Stack: React, JavaScript, Vite, Leaflet, REST API

### Custom Thread (Jun 2024 — Present)
Python library extending the standard threading module — published and maintained on PyPI.
- Extends stdlib Thread with return values, exception propagation, and callbacks
- Zero external dependencies
- MIT licensed open-source
- [Live](https://pypi.org/project/CustomThread/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/CustomThread)
- Stack: Python, Threading, PyPI

### DDGame (Feb 2026 — Present)
D&D-themed clicker built with React and TypeScript, deployed on Vercel.
- Roll the dice to earn XP and spend it in the upgrade shop
- Upgrades unlock as XP grows; strict TypeScript throughout
- [Live](https://ddgame.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/ddgame)
- Stack: TypeScript, Vite, Vercel

### MainDug Web (Dec 2024 — Present)
Open-source, self-hostable password manager — IFPR final-year project. A web rewrite of the original Python desktop app.
- Flask + PostgreSQL webservice for credentials, security stats and user administration
- Browser extension that captures logins, offers autocomplete and reports usage
- Argon2 hashing, reused and leaked (pwned) password detection, email password recovery
- pytest suite and GitHub Actions CI; full LaTeX documentation with threat model
- [Live](https://maindug.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/MainDugWeb)
- Stack: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, Browser Extension, Argon2, pytest

### Maze Solver (Jun 2025 — Present)
Interactive maze generator and pathfinding visualizer — DFS and BFS solve the same maze and are compared side by side.
- Random maze generation via depth-first backtracking on a configurable grid (9–41 rows × 9–51 columns)
- Step-by-step DFS and BFS animation with adjustable speed
- Compare mode: nodes explored, path length and execution time side by side
- Algorithms page with pseudocode, complexity and trade-offs; rewritten in React 19 + Tailwind
- [Live](https://maze.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/RedBlackTree)
- Stack: React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Algorithms, DFS, BFS

### GeoKnocker (Jun 2024 — Aug 2024)
GUI desktop tool for port scanning and IP geolocation with dark/light theme and concurrent scanning.
- Port scanning via raw Python sockets
- IP geolocation using public REST APIs
- Concurrent scans with threading for performance
- CustomTkinter GUI with dark/light theme toggle and loading animations
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/GeoKnocker)
- Stack: Python, Sockets, Threading, Tkinter, CustomTkinter

### Hash Table (Nov 2025 — Dec 2025)
Hash table implementation in C with chaining for collision resolution and automatic rehashing at 75% load factor.
- CPF-keyed records storing name and age
- Separate chaining via linked lists for collision handling
- Auto-rehash: doubles capacity when load factor ≥ 0.75
- Insert, search, delete, and statistical analysis operations
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/hashtable)
- Stack: C, Data Structures, Algorithms

### PiTest (Jun 2026 — Present)
Hardware diagnostic tool for Raspberry Pi devices — runs a test battery and reports results to a central web dashboard.
- Runs as a systemd service on every boot: 7 checks covering LAN, Wi-Fi, boot health, USB, GPIO, Bluetooth pairing and a Wi-Fi hotspot (hostapd + dnsmasq)
- The screen shows progress and test patterns; the operator confirms screen and GPIO LEDs on the dashboard
- Results go over a JSON REST API to a Flask + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL dashboard that keeps each board's history by MAC address
- Exit code reflects overall pass/fail
- [Live](https://pitest.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/pitest)
- Stack: Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, systemd, Raspberry Pi, Embedded

### Grimório de Venetia (Jun 2026 — Present)
D&D 5.5 (2024 edition) character creator and play sheet — single-page app packaged as an Android app via Capacitor.
- 13-step guided wizard: level, species, class, attributes, skills, multiclass, spells, equipment, background
- Play sheet with tabbed panels for combat, resources, spellcasting, and inventory
- Level-up flow handles ASI and multiclassing in place
- PT/EN i18n with i18next, state managed via Zustand, validation via Zod
- [Live](https://venetia.leogotardo.com.br)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/venetia-grimory)
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Capacitor

### Phishing Detector (May 2026 — Present)
Web tool for checking suspicious URLs, combining local browser heuristics with multiple external blacklist APIs.
- Local JS heuristics: digit normalization, brand-in-subdomain detection, Levenshtein distance typosquatting check
- Backend aggregates verdicts from Google Safe Browsing, VirusTotal, and URLhaus
- Registered-domain extraction handles two-level ccTLDs (.com.br, .co.uk)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/phising)
- Stack: Python, Flask, Security, Phishing Detection, REST API

### Talent Scout (Oct 2025 — Present)
Web system for registering, analyzing, and classifying athletes by physical and performance metrics using a KNN machine learning model.
- K-Nearest Neighbors model clusters athletes into Beginner, Intermediate, Competitive, or Elite tiers
- Flask + SQLAlchemy dashboard for registering, editing, and filtering athlete records
- Statistical visualization: PCA, correlation matrix, radar profile, cluster quality metrics
- CSV import/export and ZIP report generation (data + charts)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/LeoGotardo/phisics)
- Stack: Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn, Machine Learning, MVC
